metadata.name: Representative NEM capital-city network-use-of-system tariffs
metadata.description: Representative low-voltage small-business NUOS tariffs for selected NEM capital-city network areas. NUOS rates include distribution, transmission and jurisdictional-scheme components published by each distributor; they are not a complete landed electricity cost for a community developer.

usage.import_variable_price: Add the applicable import network energy rate to the AEMO spot energy price.
usage.fixed_charges: Daily fixed charges are reference data only and are not included in the optimiser's interval energy prices.
usage.export: Export rewards are applied by time. Allowance- or threshold-based export charges require billing-period state and are not applied by the current interval tariff reader.

model_limitations: The selected tariff is a representative low-voltage small-business tariff, not a site-specific quote or retail contract.
A multi-dwelling community may instead be assigned an embedded-network, demand or larger-customer tariff according to annual consumption, connection capacity, voltage and NMI arrangement.
AEMO regional reference prices are not adjusted for marginal or distribution loss factors.
Daily fixed charges and conditional export allowances are not included in optimiser interval costs.
The current tariff reader interprets working weekdays as Monday-Friday and does not exclude public holidays.
excluded_components: AEMO market participant and ancillary-service fees
competitive metering charges unless explicitly identified in a tariff row

quality_levels.official: Published network tariff values or schedules.
quality_levels.official_indicative: Published indicative values from an official tariff-structure document.
quality_levels.secondary_transcription: Contemporaneous transcription linked to published network pricing material.
quality_levels.estimated: Representative value derived from an adjacent published tariff year while preserving the selected tariff structure.

fixed_charges.selection_basis: Published >80 MWh annual-consumption fixed band, used as the representative band for an aggregated community connection.
Published highest annual-consumption fixed band, used as the representative band for an aggregated community connection.

2023-24.estimate_method: Published historical energy rates retained; daily fixed charge estimated from adjacent EA225 years.
